## Design

### 2026-10-25 – I made the schematics and footprints for the synthesizer which includes the 8 keys, a headphone jack and speaker option, and some dials to edit the sound played (volume, octave, etc.) I decided to use

**5.45h**

I made the schematics and footprints for the synthesizer which includes the 8 keys, a headphone jack and speaker option, and some dials to edit the sound played (volume, octave, etc.) I decided to use a Raspberry Pi Zero to power it after my friend (who's good at software) recommended it to me. In between my additions to the schematics, I made a lot of pauses to look up different features of synthesizers, as well as their schematics and footprints in KiCad, adding up to about 2 hours more off camera (total time was  from roughly 1:00pm till 7pm).
